newsitem.title: USA: Saratoga Brands to buy Global Auto.
newsitem.headline: Saratoga Brands to buy Global Auto.

text.p: Saratoga Brands Inc said it has reached an agreement subject to certain conditions to acquire Global Auto Group Inc.

Saratoga Brands will pay $9.8 million in Saratoga's common stock with the potential for additional consideration pursuant to the earn-out provisions. The acquisition is expected to be completed within 30 days.
Global Auto Group is in the retail auto business.
Saratoga Brands, through its subsidiaries, provides catering services to convenience stores and imports specialty foods.
Saratoga says Global Auto had revenues in excess of $25 million for its fiscal year ended December 31, 1995.

Saratoga's Chairman, Barry Witz, said Global intends to expand through both internal growth and through acquisitions. Global Auto is currently engaged in active discussions to acquire several other companies in the auto business, he said.
